title: Muldoon: Americans wanted Kaikoura shut down

tellings.quote: Anyway, he chuckled. And I remember he just let slip something like, "Yeah, the Americans wanted that one shut down pretty quickly."

plain: A journalist, Ross Coulthart, says he interviewed a man named Robert Muldoon in New Zealand in the early 1980s and asked about Kaikoura, a 1978 New Zealand case that the story ties to UFOs. Coulthart says Muldoon chuckled and let slip something like, "Yeah, the Americans wanted that one shut down pretty quickly." If true, it would mean the United States pushed to close down the case.
